There’s a considerable amount of people who want to be able to save money or will only use the app for cheap/free because they don’t like spending money on these things but still wanna use it. As a result, the current model kind of shuns these people away and this whole app and idea are amazing, so I wanna find a way to bring that to more people

Now that that’s out of the way, the idea of giving support to these people can be a simple few changes in a package

1) Daily Check-In: Give users a check in reward so that you have more users day to day which I’m pretty sure gets your app higher up on app stores

2) Mission Rewards pay for themselves and more. Currently they sometimes pay for themselves or you lose points getting them. Changing it to give users a bit extra lets them play more and enjoy the product. The current missions are fine. 

3) An ad service reward. You could have a lower quality model that people can use that runs based on ads, or just have an option to watch ads for some stars. It allows you to generate ad revenue and allows people who are not willing to pay with money but by time to still make you a profit. 

This is meant to be all parts of a package. There’s lots of financial stuff and other planning and “balancing” that goes into this but seeing it in the future could really improve user retention. Especially since some of the other popular AI RP services are being redesigned and less liked (like how I found out about this while searching for an alternative to Chai) it gives you an opportunity to burst forward.

Hi! Thank you so much for such a thoughtful suggestion, and we're really glad you found Frontia and enjoy it this much!!

We understand this as a wish for more people to enjoy Frontia comfortably, without feeling pushed away by cost, and that's something we care about too.

To keep the service running stably, Frontia offers some paid features. Even so, we're trying many different ways so that more people can play without feeling pressured, and ideas like yours really help us along the way.

Thank you for caring so much about Frontia!
